title: Simulated phiX174 demo: 2 fictional patients, 10 samples
description: Simulated reads of phage phiX174 (used only as a reference) with variants planted at known frequencies, for two fictional patients (P1: 6 dates, P2: 4 dates). Not real patient data. Expected: 8 of 9 variants labelled in P1, 2 of 9 in P2.
note: Synthetic reads made by tests/fixtures/make_bams.py (case phix) and counted with bam-readcount -q 20 -b 20 -w 0; each table was verified against tests/regression/golden/phix/MANIFEST.tsv
